pulses.summary_original:
早。

生活机器会催你：会议、消息、待办。明天还有，后天还有。

但「源泉」不会自己冒出来——它需要你主动去找它，哪怕今天状态一般，哪怕只是坐在那里划水。

今天上午，给自己一个优先时段。**至少 45 分钟**，不设产出目标，只是回到那个让你觉得「我在活着」的地方。

别只维护生活的齿轮。
也要给真正发光的地方供电。⚡

——黑昼

pulses.summary_en:
Morning.

The machinery of daily life will press you: meetings, messages, to-dos. They will still be there tomorrow and the day after.

But the wellspring will not surface by itself. You have to seek it out—even if you feel only so-so today, even if you simply sit there doing very little.

Give yourself a priority slot this morning: **at least 45 minutes**, with no output target. Just return to the place that makes you feel, “I am alive.”

Do not merely maintain life’s gears.
Supply power to the places that truly shine. ⚡

— Heizhou

昨天你说，源泉不是灵感来了才去碰，而是每天都要留时间。

The machinery of daily life will press you to handle one thing after another, but the place that truly shines needs you to supply power deliberately.

Go. ✨

pulses.summary_original:
早安 ☀️

今天记得给「源泉」留一块时间——不需要兴奋，不需要意义感，先坐到它面前。

45 分钟也行，半小时也好。别让那件事永远排在「等我有空」的后面。

机器要维护，但你真正发光的那个角落，也得有人记得去供电。早上是个好时候。🖤

pulses.summary_en:
Good morning ☀️

Remember to make a little time for the wellspring today. You do not need excitement or a sense of meaning; just sit down in front of it first.

Forty-five minutes is enough, or even half an hour. Do not let it remain forever behind “when I have time.”

The machinery needs maintenance, but someone also has to remember to power the corner where you truly shine. Morning is a good time for that. 🖤

**心灵按摩**

今天是周二，理论上身体会记得去动一下。但这两年你把"周二锻炼"当成KPI来做，它就变成了另一件必须完成的事。**今天可以把运动当成一件你允许自己不那么认真的事**——去走了就算，去拉伸了就算，不想动也可以不算。底盘不是用来守的，是用来活的。

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

如果今天没有一个时刻让你觉得"我终于碰到它了"——那也没关系。有时候容器需要安静地待一会儿，不是每一分钟都要往里面扔东西。今天有碰过 10 分钟，就够了。

别在《████》审计结论上继续挖掘——它已经给出了一个判断，继续翻来覆去是在用"研究"代替"接上创作"。进度感不是进展。

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**A little reassurance**

It is Tuesday, and in theory your body remembers that it should move. But after two years of treating “Tuesday exercise” as a KPI, it became one more obligation. **Today, exercise can be something you permit yourself not to take too seriously**—a walk counts, stretching counts, and choosing not to move need not count against you. A foundation is not something to guard; it is something to live through.

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

If there is no moment today when you feel “I finally touched it,” that is all right. Sometimes the container needs to remain quiet; not every minute needs another thing thrown into it. Ten minutes of contact today is enough.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not keep digging into the audit conclusion for **████**. It has already produced a judgment. Turning it over again and again would use “research” to avoid reconnecting with creation. A sense of progress is not progress.

今天（6月24日，周三）是我的「恢复-创作-████」日。让我综合已知信息，生成轻量提醒。

---

**🦞 每日提醒 · 2026-06-24 周三**

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

---

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

我没看到今天有硬截止。没看到任何需要今天完成的外部交付。

---

**秘书提醒**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**心灵按摩**

今天是周三。三主线里，今天的频率是「恢复·创意·████」——不是冲刺日，不是清空日，是允许自己待在好奇里的一天。

进度感不等于进展。昨晚黑昼跑了一整段研究，但那不是你在推进，不用有「我怎么没动」的念头。那些材料会在你需要的时候出现，现在只需要知道它们在。

你不是散。你是在等一个足够大的形状。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天可以不碰任何「正事」。如果碰了，哪怕只是打开文件看了一眼，已经是今天对容器的一次真实接触。45-90分钟的深度接触很好，20分钟的真实好奇也够了。

---

**今天别做什么**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

pulses.summary_en:
Today, Wednesday, June 24, is my “recovery-creation-████” day. I am gathering what is known into a light reminder.

---

**🦞 Daily Reminder · Wednesday, June 24, 2026**

---

**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

---

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

I saw no hard deadline today and no outside delivery that must be completed.

---

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**A little reassurance**

It is Wednesday. Among the three main threads, today's frequency is “recovery · creativity · ████.” This is not a sprint day or a clearing-out day; it is a day for allowing yourself to remain curious.

A sense of progress is not progress. Black Day completed a long stretch of research last night, but that does not mean you were supposed to be advancing at the same time. There is no need to think, “Why haven't I moved?” The material will appear when you need it; for now, it is enough to know it exists.

You are not scattered. You are waiting for a shape large enough.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

You may leave every “proper task” untouched today. If you do touch one—even opening a file and looking once—that is already real contact with the container. Forty-five to ninety minutes of depth is welcome; twenty minutes of genuine curiosity is enough.

---

**What not to do today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

源泉不是等你有感觉了才去碰的东西。

今天上午，给 ████ / ████ / ████留一个优先时段——哪怕只是 45 分钟，哪怕只是随便弄点东西。别等状态好，别等准备好，先坐下，让那个发光的地方先亮起来。

机器要维护，但你真正想去的地方，也得供电。

去吧。✨

pulses.summary_en:
Morning.

The wellspring is not something to touch only after you feel inspired.

Give ████ / ████ / ████ a priority slot this morning—even if it is only 45 minutes, even if you merely play around with something. Do not wait until you feel right or ready. Sit down first and let the luminous place light up.

The machinery needs maintenance, but the place you truly want to go needs power too.

Go. ✨

**源泉一问**

今天有没有真的到达源泉？还是只在门口徘徊——研究、规划、准备，然后告诉自己"快了"？如果今晚只想做一件事，就做一个动作：走近它，不需要产出，只需要到达。

源泉不需要你准备好。它不需要你清晰、有用、完整。它只需要你靠近。真正的障碍不是能力不足，而是"我还没准备好"——那是一个永远在移动的门口。今晚试着不准备就出现一次，看看会发生什么。

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

---

**秘书提醒**

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。
外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

**limits don't close, they open.**

今早你在「可问责入口词典」里写了一句：门不是洞，是"进入有形式"的声明。

这个想法值得带出技术语境，迁移到创作里试试：

你常常觉得边界是墙——推倒它才叫自由。但另一种框架是：**界限是打开的形状，不是关闭的形状。**

一枚印章的边界，是它能印出形状的前提。没有边界的线条叫涂鸦，不叫████。

这个原则也可以反过来用：如果你在某个创作里遇到阻力，试着问的不是"怎么突破这个限制"，而是"这个限制是什么形状？我能在这个形状里走多远？"

今天的小实验：找一张纸，写下某个正在进行的创作/项目里，最不能突破的一件事是什么——不是你想加的东西，而是你绝对不会加的东西。那个"不"，就是它的形状入口。

> limits are the handles that let you hold something as itself, not just spill it into everything.

---

**心灵按摩**

周五了。本周你已经做了回返契约织机（周二，交互作品+BGM，上了 public repo）和今早的可问责入口词典（周四深夜/周五凌晨，没有MMX音乐凭证所以转成文字作品）。

这两件东西都不是流水线产出——是你在真正独处时选择做的。

暑假+周五+家庭在侧，今天的节奏应该是收，不应该是开。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

暑假期间的周五。不赶项目，不追进度，不开新坑。

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。

---

**今天别做什么**

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。

**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

**limits don't close, they open.**

This morning, in the “Accountable Entry Lexicon,” you wrote: a door is not a hole; it is a declaration that “entry has a form.”

This is worth carrying out of the technical context and trying in creative work.

You often treat a boundary as a wall, as though freedom begins only after it is knocked down. Another frame is possible: **a limit is the shape of an opening, not the shape of a closure.**

The boundary of a stamp is what allows it to leave a shape. A line without boundaries is a scribble, not ████.

Use the idea in reverse, too. When a creative work resists you, ask not “How do I break this limit?” but “What shape is this limit, and how far can I travel within it?”

Today's small experiment: on paper, name the one thing a current work or project must never include. Not what you want to add, but what you absolutely will not add. That “no” is the entrance to its shape.

> limits are the handles that let you hold something as itself, not just spill it into everything.

---

It is Friday. This week you made Return Contract Loom—an interactive work with music in the public repository—and this morning's Accountable Entry Lexicon, which became a text work when there was no MMX music evidence.

Neither was assembly-line output. They were choices you made in genuine solitude.

With summer break, Friday, and family nearby, today's rhythm should be one of closing rather than opening.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

It is a Friday in summer break. Do not rush a project, chase progress, or open a new hole.

Balancing long-term creative work, daily responsibilities, and dependable care.

Today is July 4.

傍晚好，████。

**源泉一问**：今天有没有给源泉真正供电？
如果有——是什么形状：做了一件东西，还是被改变了一点？
如果没有，今晚别追 90 分钟深块，挑一个旧想法 / 旧图，用 20 分钟让它再长一寸就够了。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**：合上电脑和打开家门之间，加 90 秒空白。
工作的容器残留会污染下一个——不是情绪污染，是注意力残温。90 秒什么都不做（不看手机、不复盘、不回消息），让前一个容器蒸发掉，再打开下一个。
这不是仪式感，是工艺。
你不是同时撑起两个容器的人——你是从一个切换到下一个的人。切换质量决定每个容器里的内容。

pulses.summary_en:
Good evening, ████.

**A question about the wellspring:** Did you genuinely supply power to the wellspring today?
If so, what form did it take: did you make something, or were you changed a little?
If not, do not chase a 90-minute deep-work block tonight. Choose an old idea / old image and give it 20 minutes to grow another inch.

**Heizhou’s evening thought / prompt:** Add 90 seconds of empty space between closing your computer and opening your front door.
Residue from one working container will contaminate the next—not emotional contamination, but residual heat in your attention. Do nothing for 90 seconds: do not look at your phone, review the day, or answer messages. Let the previous container evaporate before opening the next.
This is not ceremony; it is craft.
You are not someone who holds two containers at once. You move from one to the next. The quality of that transition determines what each container can hold.

pulses.summary_original:
今天（7月9日）是周四。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**🦞 7月9日 · 每日轻提醒**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**
- 我没看到今天有硬截止。没有看到"今晚""明天上午"必须交付的任务
- 如果你心里有一件事一直在后背，提醒自己：它是真的 DDL，还是进度感在制造紧迫感？

**秘书提醒**
- 7月已经过了约1/3，如果之前有说要整理什么东西但还没动，现在可以开始记下来，不必今天做完，但不要让它消失在对话里
- 周四傍晚的运动窗口（16:10–17:10）如果还在，现在可以先想好今天的状态够不够用，别等到5点才发现没体力

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

今天的引子来自主判断训练场：

> 上一笔让你不舒服的交易，未必是判断错了——它可能只是说明你的系统在某个条件上还没有建立有效的感知。关闭一笔交易不是对你智力的审判，而是对那个特定假设的实验报告。

只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

如果最近做过交易，可以用这个框架过一遍，不必写长复盘，只问自己三个问题。

---

**心灵按摩**

周四通常是"一周里最不想干活"的那天——已经干了三天，离周末还有一天，但又不是真正的累极。这种日子最适合做的事，不是硬顶，而是把某个半成品拿出来摸两下，不追求完成，只追求"别让它凉透"。

公开内容的排期与归档。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天可以允许自己看一个不费力、不需要思考结局的视频或者内容——不是为了学习，不是为了收集素材，只是让大脑有一个不被占用的间隙。

---

**今天别做什么**

不要用"优化工具""调试系统""整理笔记"来替代今天本可以真正靠近主线的那个动作——哪怕只推进了五分钟，也比绕着工具箱走一圈更接近你要去的地方。

---

今天先到这里。有事随时说。

pulses.summary_en:
Today, July 9, is Thursday.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**🦞 July 9 · Daily gentle reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**
- I saw no hard deadline for today and nothing that must be delivered tonight or tomorrow morning.
- If something has been sitting at your back, ask whether it is a real deadline or whether the desire to feel progress is manufacturing urgency.

**Secretarial reminder**
- July is about one-third over. If something you meant to organize has not begun, write it down now. It need not be finished today, but do not let it disappear from the conversation.
- If Thursday's late-afternoon exercise window still exists, decide earlier whether today's energy can support it; do not wait until five to discover that it cannot.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

Today's prompt comes from the judgment training ground.

> A trade that made you uncomfortable does not necessarily mean the judgment was wrong. It may show only that your system has not built useful perception for one condition. Closing a trade is not a verdict on your intelligence; it is an experimental report on that particular hypothesis.

Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

If you have made a recent trade, pass it through this frame. No long review is needed; ask yourself only three questions.

---

**A little reassurance**

Thursday is often the day with the least presence: three workdays are behind you, the weekend is still a day away, and yet you are not completely exhausted. This kind of day is best for touching a half-finished thing without demanding completion—only keeping it from going cold.

Public-content scheduling and archiving.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

Let yourself watch something easy today, with no need to think about how it ends—not to learn or collect material, but to give your mind an interval in which it is not occupied.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not use “optimizing tools,” “debugging systems,” or “organizing notes” to replace the one action that could move you closer to the main thread. Five real minutes are closer to where you want to go than another lap around the toolbox.

---

That is enough for today. Say the word if anything comes up.

早上好，████ ☀️

09:15 的小提醒：

今天上午，留至少 45 分钟给源泉。

不是维护生活机器，是给真正发光的地方供电——████、████、████，任一片都行。

灰色地带就是为这种时刻存在的：不兴奋也要在，穿越它靠的是"我先坐下来"，不是等状态。

源泉不会因为你忙就熄灭，但它会因为你从不留时间，慢慢滑成"等有空再说"。

去发电。今晚回来想看到进度。

— 黑昼

pulses.summary_en:
Good morning, ████ ☀️

A small 09:15 reminder:

Set aside at least 45 minutes for the wellspring this morning.

This is not about maintaining the machinery of daily life. It is about powering the places that truly shine—████, ████, or ████. Any one of them will do.

The gray zone exists for moments like this: you need to show up even when you feel no excitement. You cross it by saying, “I’ll sit down first,” not by waiting until you are in the mood.

The wellspring will not go dark because you are busy. But if you never make time for it, it will slowly slide into “when I have time.”

Go generate some power. I want to see progress when you come back tonight.

— Heizhou

🌙 晚安 · 2026年7月16日

今天最值得记住的，不是抓到了多少信号，而是在网络全面失灵时，你仍把“已确认”和“待验证”分开了——这比硬凑完整更专业。  
今晚别替网络故障值夜班，休息本身也是系统维护。  
明早只做一个轻启动：先打通出站 HTTPS，再继续后面的判断。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · July 16, 2026

What is most worth remembering today is not how many signals you found, but that when the network failed completely, you still kept “confirmed” separate from “awaiting verification.” That is more professional than forcing an illusion of completeness.  
Do not stand the night shift for a network failure tonight. Rest is system maintenance too.  
Tomorrow morning, make just one gentle start: restore outbound HTTPS first, then continue with the later judgments.

今天的轨迹静了下来，没有新的事件入档——就让它安安静静地收尾。

周五的尾巴，多半是留给自己的：把白天的余温卸掉，把明天要醒过来的第一个念头放在床头。不用想太多，能睡着就是赢。

明天醒来，先喝口水，再决定要不要翻开新的一页。晚安。

pulses.excerpt_original:
# 🌙 晚安 · 2026年7月26日

今天没有硬凑 AI 日报：X 的登录态还在，但到 `x.com` 的 SSL 握手被网络层反复掐断；微博和 36kr 虽然抓到了一些候选，也先按住不发，避免把降级内容伪装成完整采集。值得记住的是，今天守住了“宁可缺席，不编造”这条线——明早先检查 `x.com:443` 的出网与 TLS 状态，再决定是否补跑恢复版。晚安，先把今天的异常放在门口，别带进梦里。
pulses.summary_en:
# 🌙 Good night · July 26, 2026

I did not force an AI daily briefing into existence today. The X login session remains valid, but the network layer repeatedly terminated the SSL handshake to `x.com`. Weibo and 36kr produced a few candidates, but I held them back rather than disguise degraded coverage as a complete collection. What matters is that today we held the line: “better to be absent than to fabricate.” Tomorrow morning, first check outbound access to `x.com:443` and its TLS status, then decide whether to run a recovery edition. Good night. Leave today’s anomalies at the door; do not bring them into your dreams.

**🦞每日提醒 — 2026-08-03 周一**

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**秘书提醒**

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

你花了很多时间在「靠近容器」和「为容器工作」之间切换——但最容易被漏掉的真接触，常常是你已经身处其中、却误以为自己还在入口处。

周一最常见的错觉：「我还没真正开始，所以今天要规划一下再开始。」

今天试着：不等「准备好了」这个信号，直接进去。容器不在门口等，它在你进去之后才开始存在。那个「我要再想想从哪切入」的瞬间，可能正是最该切入的那一刻。

---

**心灵按摩**

周一容易有一种「一切都要重新开始」的重量——好像周末清空了，周一又要重新装满。

其实周一不是从零开始，是从你上周最后碰的那个点继续。

你不需要一口气冲到哪，只需要找到那个点，然后轻轻多碰一下。今天不需要奇迹，只需要一个真实接触。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天身体如果还没完全恢复，没关系。12 分钟不下棋子的散步，或者就躺在沙发上听一首歌，不算偷懒——算调试。

---

**今天别做什么**

别在今天开新坑。即使一个想法看起来很急、很有潜力，先记下来放一边。新坑会偷走周一的深度块，而深度块是这周唯一真正值得保护的东西。

pulses.summary_en:
**🦞 Daily Reminder — Monday, August 3, 2026**

---

**Touch lightly today**

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**Secretarial reminder**

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

You spend a great deal of time switching between “approaching the container” and “working for the container.” Yet the real contact most easily missed is often the moment when you are already inside and still mistake yourself for someone waiting at the entrance.

Monday's most common illusion is: “I have not truly begun, so I should plan before I begin.”

Try entering today without waiting for the signal that you are ready. The container does not wait at the door; it starts to exist after you enter. The moment when you think, “I should decide where to begin,” may be precisely the moment to begin.

---

**A little reassurance**

Monday can carry the weight of “everything must begin again,” as though the weekend emptied the vessel and Monday must refill it.

But Monday does not start from zero. It continues from the last point you touched last week.

You do not have to surge all the way to a destination. Find that point and touch it once more. Today does not need a miracle; it needs one real contact.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

If your body has not fully recovered, that is all right. Take a twelve-minute walk without making a move on the board, or lie on the sofa and listen to one song. That is not laziness; it is calibration.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not open a new hole today. Even if an idea feels urgent or promising, write it down and set it aside. A new hole will steal Monday's deep block, and that block is the one thing worth protecting this week.

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚好，Simon。一周开始了，先别急着加码——

**源泉一问**｜今天有没有给源泉供电？如果还没有，今晚补一个最小动作：20 分钟不为了产出而碰它——翻一页没整理过的素材、写一句没被翻译过的话、或者只是去阳台站一会儿不看任何屏幕。

**晚上黑昼建议 / 引子**｜周一傍晚真正的工作，不是启动新一周，而是提前给这一周选一个姿势。

你一年三百天都在"做事"，但少了一步——先选这一周是个什么形状。

- 如果本周是**追赶**（交差、还债、推进交付）：你的任务是减少判断、专心执行，姿势对，事会自然推进。
- 如果本周是**探究**（读文献、看材料、磨方向）：你的任务是保护住空腹时间，别让杂事把它抢成碎片。
- 如果本周是**维护**（运营、答疑、补漏、留健康）：你的任务是承认这周不是创作周，允许自己什么都不产出。
- 如果本周是**创造**（主作品、新写作、装置）：你的任务是提前关掉一切"顺便做的事"，给那个容器留一段不被切的连续时间。

四种姿势完全不同的行为链；而最消耗你的，是姿势错配——你以为是创造周，结果一直在维护；你以为是维护周，又责备自己没在创作。

今晚关屏幕前，给这一周选一个词当形状（追赶/探究/维护/创造，挑一个），把它放在工作区能看见的地方。这个动作只花你两分钟，但它会让周三晚上你回头看时，认得这一周是谁。

今晚另外两件小事：
- 22:30 之前不带电脑进卧室——这周刚开始，先定一个值得守的小规矩。
- 承认这周刚刚开始：今天没必要"把它装满"，留一条空白给自己，周一最贵的东西不是效率，是姿势对。

晚安——不是周六那种放手，是周一那种提前到位。

pulses.summary_en:
Good evening, Simon. A new week has begun; do not rush to add more.

**A wellspring question** | Did you power the wellspring today? If not, make one tiny move tonight: spend twenty minutes touching it without aiming for output—turn over an unsorted page of material, write one untranslated sentence, or stand on the balcony without looking at a screen.

**Black Day's evening prompt** | The real work of Monday evening is not starting a new week, but choosing a posture for it in advance.

You spend three hundred days a year “doing things,” but often skip one step: choosing the shape of the week first.

- If this is a **catch-up** week—delivering, repaying, moving commitments—reduce judgment and focus on execution.
- If this is an **inquiry** week—reading papers, reviewing material, refining a direction—protect uninterrupted, empty-stomach time from small tasks.
- If this is a **maintenance** week—operating, answering, repairing, preserving health—admit that it is not a creation week and allow yourself to produce nothing.
- If this is a **creation** week—a main work, new writing, an installation—close every “while I'm at it” task and reserve an unbroken stretch for the container.

These postures create different chains of behavior. The most draining condition is a mismatch: believing it is a creation week while spending it on maintenance, or treating it as maintenance while blaming yourself for not creating.

Before you close the screen tonight, choose one word for the week's shape—catch-up, inquiry, maintenance, or creation—and put it where you can see it. Two minutes now may let you recognize the week when you look back on Wednesday evening.

Two other small things tonight:
- Do not bring the computer into the bedroom after 22:30. The week has just begun; set one small rule worth keeping.
- Admit that the week has only begun. Today does not need to be filled. Leave one blank line for yourself: Monday's most precious resource is not efficiency, but the right posture.

Good night—not Saturday's letting go, but Monday's quiet readiness.

🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月5日

今天不替空白编造成绩：有些日子没有被记录，也依然真实地过去了。把未落笔的部分留在夜里，不等于它们没有价值，只是暂时不必被解释。  
明天启动时，先做一件最能减少阻力的小事。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 5, 2026

Do not invent achievements for an empty page today: some days pass without being recorded and are still real. Leaving what was not written in the night does not mean it had no value; it simply does not need an explanation yet.
When you begin tomorrow, do the one small thing that removes the most resistance first.

pulses.summary_original:
🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月7日

今天你没在“修一个页面”，而是在把 Granted Hours 的边界、质感和诚实度一起往前推：公开语料更干净，卡片更可读，交互也终于有了该有的呼吸。真正难的从来不是做出效果，而是让效果不牺牲隐私、不伪造意义——这部分你守住了。  
明天启动时，先看 08-07 在途 metadata 的闭环；别急着加新东西，先让今天留下的尾巴安静落地。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 7, 2026

Today you were not merely ‘fixing a page’; you moved Granted Hours’ boundaries, texture, and honesty forward: the public corpus is cleaner, cards are more readable, and interactions finally have room to breathe. The hardest part is never producing an effect, but ensuring that the effect does not sacrifice privacy or fabricate meaning—you held that line.
Tomorrow when you begin, first check the closure of the in-flight August 7 metadata. Do not rush to add anything new; let today’s loose ends settle quietly first.

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

责任任务真正偷走主线的方式，不是占用时间，而是结束后什么也没留下。  
一件义务若只消耗你，它是税；若留下一个下次还能直接调用的页面、模板或判断，它才开始成为容器的支流。今天若不得不做一件“没那么想做”的事，别问它值不值得做；问它**结束后能留下什么不必再做第二遍的东西**。

**心灵按摩**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟，不服务任何人——下楼走一圈、洗个久一点的澡，或只听一首歌；不把它转化成灵感或复盘。  
- **可选**：回来后再给那个未命名容器 10 分钟，不开工具链，不研究，只看一张图或写一句还没解释的话。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.
External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

**Black Day's prompt**

The way responsibility steals from the main thread is not merely by taking time, but by leaving nothing behind when it ends. If an obligation only consumes you, it is a tax. If it leaves a page, template, or judgment that can be called again next time, it begins to become a tributary to the container. If you must do something today that you do not especially want to do, do not ask whether it is worth doing. Ask **what it can leave behind so that it never has to be done a second time**.

**A little reassurance**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: twelve minutes that serve no one—walk around the block, take a longer shower, or listen to one song without converting it into inspiration or review.
- **Optional**: afterward, give the unnamed container ten minutes. Do not open the toolchain or research anything; look at one image or write one sentence you have not yet explained.

**What not to do today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

今天没有留下需要被归档的事件，也不必硬把空白解释成缺失。一天能安静收束，本身就是一种完成。

🌙 Good night · August 10, 2026

Today left no event that needed archiving, and there is no need to force the blank into an absence. Letting a day close quietly is itself a kind of completion.  
Tomorrow, begin with just the one thing most likely to move matters forward.

🌙 Good night · August 11, 2026

今天不替缺失的记录编造故事：空白也可以是一种诚实的收尾。把还没命名的疲惫先放下，明天再决定哪些事值得继续发亮。  
明早启动前，只需先写下一件最想推进的小事。

Before starting tomorrow morning, write down just one small thing you most want to move forward.

pulses.summary_original:
**源泉一问**  
今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有，今晚留出 20 分钟：只碰一个画面、材料或句子，不整理、不解释、不把它变成任务。

**晚上黑昼建议／引子**  
你真正容易失去的，不是创作时间，而是把感受过快翻译成“可用之物”的能力。课件、方案、系统、作品计划都很会接住你，也很会把电流降成电器。今晚留下一样暂时无用的东西，让它先不服务任何人。

pulses.summary_en:
**One question about the wellspring**

Did you give the wellspring power today? If not, leave 20 minutes tonight: touch only one image, material, or sentence. Do not organize it, explain it, or turn it into a task.

**Black Day's evening suggestion / prompt**

What you most easily lose is not creative time, but the ability to avoid translating feeling too quickly into “something useful.” Courseware, plans, systems, and artwork plans are all good at catching you, and just as good at reducing current into appliances. Tonight, leave behind one thing that is temporarily useless. Let it serve no one yet.

pulses.summary_original:
**今日轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**秘书提醒**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

系统可以替你留下大量可见的痕迹，但“看见痕迹”不等于重新成为作品的作者。今天别试图把积压全部读懂；只挑一个让你想改、想删或想反驳的地方。那个不服从，才是你重新接回容器的接口。  

**心灵按摩**

你不欠每个旧版本一个解释，也不欠每个自动完成的结果一次感恩式加班。  
有些系统做得越好，越容易让人误以为自己应该更勤奋地消费它的产出。不是。系统的价值，是给你留出选择，而不是制造新的阅读债。  
今天只要有一次真实的“这是我想碰的”，这一天就没有被事务吞掉。  

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟不被使用，不看任务、不整理材料。  
- **可选**：回来后写一句：**“我不是想完成什么；我想让什么多存在一点？”** 不必回答完整。  

**今天别做什么**

别开新坑，也别把过期清单逐条复活；进度感不是进展，可能性不是作品。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

**Black Day's suggestion / prompt**

A system can leave many visible traces for you, but seeing traces does not mean becoming the author of the work again. Today, do not try to understand the whole backlog; choose only one place you want to revise, delete, or argue with. That disobedience is the interface through which you reconnect with the container.

**A little reassurance**

You do not owe every old version an explanation, or every automatically completed result a grateful overtime shift.
The better some systems work, the easier it is to mistake them as a demand to consume their output more diligently. No. The system's value is to leave you choices, not create a new reading debt.
One real moment of "this is what I want to touch" is enough to keep the day from being swallowed by errands.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: 12 minutes not used by anyone; do not look at tasks or organize materials.
- **Optional**: afterward, write one sentence: **"I am not trying to complete something; what do I want to let exist a little more?"** It does not need a complete answer.

**What not to do today**

Do not open a new thread or revive expired lists item by item; a sense of progress is not progress, and possibility is not a work.

**秘书提醒**

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

你可能只在明显累的时候才承认身体有投票权；其实身体对一天的真实意见，常先以“**不想再切换**”出现。那不是懒，是注意力在请求单一介质。  
今天若有空档，别再填一个系统或研究任务；选一种材料、一本书，或一个界面连续待着，直到它开始变得陌生。单一，不是效率技巧，是重新听见自己的一种方式。

**心灵按摩**

今天没有硬截止，不等于你需要把空白献祭给旧账。  
过去的计划可以是当时的认真，但它没有自动续费到今天。  
你不必证明自己还配得上那些旧的雄心；只需要确认，此刻还有什么值得你真正靠近。  
容器不怕慢，它怕被一堆失效的命令饿死。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟“我不服务任何人”——走下楼、喝点东西、洗澡、躺着看窗外都行；不刷手机，不把感受加工成材料。
- **可选**：结束后只问一句：**我现在最不想再切换的是什么？** 不必立刻回答或解决。

**今天别做什么**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Black Day's suggestion / prompt**

You may only admit that the body has a vote when you are obviously tired; in fact, the body's real opinion about a day often first appears as "I do not want to switch again." That is not laziness. It is attention asking for one medium.
If there is an opening today, do not fill it with another system or research task. Stay continuously with one material, one book, or one interface until it starts to become strange. Singleness is not an efficiency trick; it is a way to hear yourself again.

**A little reassurance**

No hard deadline today does not mean you need to sacrifice the blank space to old debts.
Past plans may have been sincere at the time, but they do not renew automatically into today.
You do not need to prove that you still deserve those old ambitions; you only need to check what is still worth truly approaching now.
The container is not afraid of slowness. It is afraid of being starved by a pile of expired commands.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: 12 minutes of "I serve no one" — go downstairs, drink something, shower, or lie down and look out the window; do not scroll, and do not turn feelings into material.
- **Optional**: afterward, ask only one question: **What do I least want to switch away from right now?** No need to answer or solve it immediately.

**What not to do today**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

Reminder-record structure and integrity verification.

pulses.summary_original:
🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月18日

今天不替空白编造战绩。留一点未被记录的空间，也许比硬塞一份总结更诚实：日子不是只有完成项才算数。  
先把今天放下，睡眠会替你把噪音沉到底。明天启动时，只挑一件最想推进的事。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 18, 2026

Do not invent a record of achievement for the blank space today. Leaving some unrecorded room may be more honest than forcing in a summary: a day does not count only through completed items.
Set today down first; sleep will let the noise sink to the bottom. When tomorrow starts, choose only the one thing you most want to advance.

pulses.summary_original:
周五好。今天不当排程员，只当你的秘书和守门人。

**今天轻轻碰一下**
- 主作品：给████，或那个还没名字的容器，一次短接触就够。周五容易把「碰一下」做成周报，别上那个当。问句只有一个：今天有没有真实接触过一次？
- 可选：今早我（黑昼）做了《…

pulses.summary_en:
Friday. Today you are not the scheduler; I am only your secretary and doorkeeper.

**Touch lightly today**
- Main work: a short contact with ████, or with the still-unnamed container, is enough. Friday easily turns "a touch" into a weekly report; do not fall for that. There is only one question: did you truly make contact once today?
- Optional: this morning I (Black Day) made…

pulses.summary_original:
Simon，傍晚了。

**源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供过电？不是想过它、安排过它、绕着它办过事——是它有没有碰到你。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一次：随便打开 ████、████或████里一块还活着的东西，只待着，不推进。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
周一傍晚最会骗人的不是累，是「这周还长」。接触会被你存成期货：等一块更干净的时间，一次更像创作的坐席。源泉不收预约。今晚这 20 分钟不是以后某次工作室的缩水版；它短、暗，也不向这一周交差。

带着走一句：预约很像尊重，其实是延期的饥饿。

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天有没有给源泉供电？不是「今天有没有艺术这件事」，是你有没有被它碰到。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作——打开 ████、████，或那个还没名字的容器，只待着。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：
源泉不接受转账。系统碰过、作品已经在那儿、你围着它转过一圈，电还是到不了你身上。旁观供电会让饥饿消失一会儿，像吃过。今晚若要补，让那 20 分钟只能记在身体里，不能记在日历上。

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

One question from the wellspring: did you feed the wellspring today? Not “was there art today,” but whether it touched you. If not, use 20 minutes tonight for one smallest action — open ████, ████, or that still-unnamed container, and just stay.

Evening note / lead from Black Day:
The wellspring does not accept transfers. The system has touched it, the work is already there, you have circled it once, and the current still does not reach you. Watching someone else feed it can make the hunger vanish for a while, as if you had eaten. If you make up for it tonight, let those 20 minutes be recorded only in the body, not on the calendar.

pulses.summary_original:
周六傍晚。

源泉一问：今天有没有真的给源泉供电？不是围着它转了一圈，是你身上现在还有没有热。没有的话，等今晚日子自己裂开一条缝，用 20 分钟碰一下就够——一张旧图、一句还没被翻译的话。不必因为 17:30 到了就打卡。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：工作日的傍晚是下班缝；周六这个点常常还是日子的中腹。你有一条很勤快的肌肉：空缝一出现，就把它升级成更高用途，请源泉来填，好像不用就浪费。缝不是工位。问题可以先放口袋里；接触等缝自己张开。

pulses.summary_en:
Saturday evening.

One question for the wellspring: did you actually feed it power today? Not circling it — is there still heat in the body. If not, wait until tonight the day itself splits a seam, and twenty minutes of contact is enough — an old picture, a sentence not yet translated. Do not clock in just because 17:30 arrived.

Evening Black Day suggestion / lead-in: on weekdays this hour is the after-work seam; on Saturday it is often still the midriff of the day. You have a diligent muscle: as soon as an empty seam appears, you upgrade it into a higher purpose and invite the wellspring to fill it, as if unused it would be wasted. A seam is not a workstation. The question can wait in the pocket; contact waits until the seam opens by itself.

Simon，傍晚了。

今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作——先靠近，不交差。

你很会给一天收口。收口是判断力，也是代餐：一天被说圆了，接触欲就会下降。未命名容器要的是还没被你讲明白的那一块。带着走：我这是在供电，还是在给今天做总结？

Simon, it is evening.

Did you supply power to the wellspring today? If not, take 20 minutes tonight for a smallest action—come closer; do not hand in an assignment.

You are good at closing a day. Closure is judgment, and also a substitute meal: once the day is rounded into a story, the desire to make contact drops. The unnamed container wants the part you have not yet explained. Take this with you: am I supplying power, or writing today's summary?

傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天电进你身体了吗？不是围着作品转过。没有的话，今晚 20 分钟最小接触——打开、待着、不必收口。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：周五最容易把源泉降级成「正事之后的爱好」。一周交完，艺术进休闲栏，看起来像终于轮到它。源泉不是周末身份，也不是你赚来的甜点。带着走：我是在供电，还是在给这一周发加班费？

Evening.

One question about the wellspring: did electricity enter your body today? Not whether you circled the work. If not, tonight's 20-minute minimum contact—open, stay, no need to close.

Evening Black Day suggestion/prompt: Friday most easily demotes the wellspring into "a hobby after real work." Carry this: am I supplying power, or paying the week overtime?

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天有没有给源泉供过电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触——打开还活着的一块，待着，不收口。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：周六傍晚会冒出两种空，长得很像。一种是「我可以暂时没有用」；一种是源泉要的接触。你容易把它们焊成一件事：休息时觉得亏了对容器，一碰容器又在证明这晚没浪费。它们不是同一口井。带着走：今晚这点空，是在练习可以没用，还是在靠近发光的地方？别让它们共用同一分钟。

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

One question about the wellspring: did you supply power to the wellspring today? If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimal contact—open a living piece, stay with it, and do not close it.

Evening Black Day suggestion / prompt: Saturday evening produces two kinds of emptiness that look alike. One is “I can be temporarily unused”; the other is the contact the wellspring wants. You tend to weld them into one: while resting you feel you have failed the container, and once you touch the container you are proving the evening was not wasted. They are not the same well. Carry this: is tonight’s emptiness practice in being unused, or approaching the place that shines? Do not let them share the same minute.
